data.name: Garson
data.long_meaning: The name Garson is an Old English name derived from the words 'Gar' and 'son'. 'Gar' means 'spear', and 'son' means 'son'. Thus, Garson can be translated to mean 'Son of a spear'. Historically, this name may have been given to a warrior or to a child born during a time of war.
